events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and songwriting with The Pretenders have given us decades of incredible rock anthems. Which Pretenders track is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a celebrated solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad for it Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, his swagger and sound are unmistakable. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine 1975
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon released the timeless anthem 'Imagine' in the UK. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of 007, from iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and a legendary solo artist, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide. What's the John Lennon song that resonates most with you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From 'Ministry of Silly Walks' to 'Fawlty Towers,' his genius has shaped British comedy. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in 1991. His incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul' in the UK. This album marked a pivotal shift in their sound and influence. What's your standout track from this classic?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's Death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon in New York City in 1980.}

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: On this day in 1980, the world lost a musical visionary, John Lennon. His legacy of peace, love, and iconic songs lives on. What's the song that best captures his spirit for you?
